routes.name: Varzia relics, as Zhuge Prime
routes.cost: 1 Aya a relic during her Prime Resurgence, Rare Barrel, 12h build

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 1 per relic; bank it before the window opens

groups.activity: buy the Zhuge Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each
groups.meta: only while Zhuge Prime is in Prime Resurgence

live.text: vaulted; only during her Prime Resurgence

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Zhuge Prime String
rows.note: Lith G3 or Lith N5 or Meso W1 or Neo E3 or Neo I1 or Axi A11 or Axi M1 or Axi T5, Common: 25.33% Intact

conditions: Refine Rare relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Common-part relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
